info.name: Request to Pay via QR Code API
Retrieve a List of Payment Links

params.name: fromDate
params.description: Specify the date time from which you want to start retrieving the Payment Links

params.name: toDate
params.description: Specify the date time until which you want to retrieve the Payment Links generated. Format expected- `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss`+/-time offset to UTC

params.name: paymentLinkStatus
params.description: Search by payment link status (whether the qr is linked to a payment link or not)

params.name: pageSize
params.description: For pagination, total number of results to return per page

params.name: cursor
params.description: For selecting a cursor when using pagination

items.docs:
**Retrieves a list of Payment Links**
 
 *Note*: 
   - Mandatory: Specify the date range
   - Maximum permissible date range: **one month**
   - Maximum historical data access: Up to **one year** from the current date

|Market     |Description                                                                        |
|:--------------------------|:------------------------------------------------------------------|
|Brazil                     |Standard

**Generates a new Payment Link**

|Market     |Description                                                                        |
|:--------------------------|:------------------------------------------------------------------|
|Brazil                     |Standard                                                           |
|Singapore                  |Does Not Apply                                                     |

  |Market     |Description                                                                        |

  |Brazil                     |Standard                                                           |
  |Singapore                  |Does not Apply                                                     |

**Creates a Payment Request based on the payments details provided:**
- **Brazil** :  returns a Payment Link and an optional QR code for digital payment
- **Singapore** : returns QR Code for digital payment
- **Hong Kong** : returns QR Code for digital payment
